title: Akhil Vempali
text: Hi! I’m Akhil. I’m a Machine Learning Engineer at Atlassian working with LLMs.

title: Akhil Vempali
text:
Experience

 Atlassian
I am currently an ML Engineer at Atlassian, working on Rovo Dev and applied AI systems for developer productivity.

Shipped production features for Rovo Dev CLI/TUI, including session hooks, slash commands, PR review flows, and agent-session capture.
Improved reliability by fixing Sentry-backed crashes across session restore, deferred tool calls, ACP MCP server mapping, terminal I/O, and Textual widget lifecycles.
Built observability and evaluation tooling with Sentry, OpenTelemetry, MLflow, Databricks, and Bitbucket Pipelines.
Developed agentic workflows for Jira issue scoping, PR analysis, SWE-bench style evaluations, and AI-assisted code review.
Added platform hardening for security, CI/CD, model selection, logging, tracing, and cross-platform file handling.



 Netomi
Since July’19 I have been working at Netomi as an ML Engineer and a Data Scientist. It has been a wonderful experience with great teammates and mentors I got the opportunity to learn a lot about software engineering, data science and machine learning. Some of my key skills I picked up at Netomi are

Working with Open Source LLMs and optimising them using SOTA techniques.
Working with LLM frameworks to develop great products
Developing enterprise grade services utilising LLMs and similar scale models to serve high volume traffic.



 Fractal Analytics
This was my first job out of university! Here I worked as a consultant, I worked with visualising and transforming huge volumes of data for major Fortune 500 companies.
